title: Along the Working Harbour
transcript: Morning, everyone. If you're here for the harbour walk, you've found the right group. Our first stop is the clock tower, just beyond the ticket office. We'll pause there while I explain how boats used to signal that they needed a berth. After that, we'll follow the painted line along the quay. It's there to keep pedestrians clear of the vans, which can be quite hard to hear above the wind. We'll stop for a short break at the ferry shelter, where there are benches out of the wind. The route then takes us past the old fish market. We'll stay outside the building today because the floor inside is being repaired. Finally, we'll finish at the harbour steps. If you're heading back to the town centre, I'll point out a shortcut that avoids walking all the way back round the basin.

questions.explanation: 导游说步行游览的第一站是售票处后面的钟楼。

questions.prompt: Guide to follow along the quay: painted ____
questions.explanation: 导游请大家沿码头地面画出的线行走，以避开货车。
团队会在设有避风长椅的渡轮候船亭短暂休息。

questions.prompt: Why will the group stay outside the old fish market?
options: The building has been booked for an event.
The entrance is blocked by delivery vans.
questions.explanation: 导游说旧鱼市的室内地面正在维修，因此团队会留在外面。

questions.prompt: What will the guide point out at the end?
options: A quicker way back to the town centre
The stop for the next ferry
A place to watch boats entering the harbour
questions.answer: A quicker way back to the town centre
questions.explanation: 行程结束时，导游会指一条回市中心的近路。
